text: Erva Tronc

Vasaria
Zianga
Ooh, you came at the right time!\nI have some concerns about the animals that live\nin this world...
Since the animals that live around here are\nherbivorous, we are often attacked for food, but\nlately the attacks have become more frequent.
Many times they were actually possessed by\nCoenubia, but these days all the animals seem to\nbe agitated and giving off those restless vibes...
Therefore, you should be very careful when you\nwalk through the forest.
Don't you have anything else to ask? Or perhaps\nsomething you wanna double check with me?\nThere's no need to hesitate, just ask me.
Tell me about the humans here.
Tell me about the monsters.
Tell me about Lixi.
Tell me about Coenubia.
I'm all good, thanks!
Besides Eumanos like us, in the world of Toram,\nthere are also Ranas that live in water and Lixis.
Although mainly living in water, sometimes the\nRanas spend time on land to sell stuff collected\nfrom the water. We interact with them quite often.
There are also some other tribes, although they\nare few in number.
The creatures you saw in the forest are unique to\nthis world. They may look like monsters and can be\ndangerous, but we don't call them monsters...
Since they're herbivores and prey on us too, we\nsometimes fight them to protect ourselves, but we\ndon't kill them unless necessary.
But the dragons are different. Their existence\nhas no meaning. They're just evil beings that are\nkilling for fun.
The dragons and Coenubias are the ones we should\nbe calling monsters...
The Lixis are also the indigenous tribes of Toram\njust like us and the Ranas.
They used to live underground and avoid\ninteracting with other tribes, but Coenubias\npossessed and turned them into their armies...
Maybe Anono was sent to your world to see if the\nLixis that have become their armies would also be\nan effective means of attack in your world...
Where they came from still remains a mystery.\nThey invaded Toram long ago.
They are an amorphous colony with intelligence\nthat is composed of many creatures of the same\nkind that come together...
That thing sent out Coenubias that could control\nothers to Toram and they were controlling all\nLixis, one of the 3 indigenous tribes.
It happened at such a tremendous speed that at one\npoint, 2/3 of Toram was under their control...
However, since we learned that Coenubia's\nweakness is water, the Eumanos and the Ranas have\nbeen working together to fight back and
we have succeeded in getting back half of Toram.\nBut Coenubias are still at an advantage in areas\nwhere there is not much water.
Lately they've also come up with a countermeasure\nto attack us and our battle has reached\ndeadlock...
Ohh, you're alive!!\nI knew that you would survive for sure...
Hi there...\nI've heard your story from this young goddess.
I'm Kinda, the chief leader of the Eumanos.\nAlright, this way please...
Aye~? A small kid...??
Aye?! Why aren't you guys surprised?
Well, we've got used to this kind of thing. We've\nseen a heinous empress that was actually a little\ngirl whose true form was actually a monster...
Dear heroes that the young goddess and Arbol\napprove of, on behalf of everyone, lemme welcome\nyou again to Erva Tronc, the town of Eumanos...
We Eumanos are the forest inhabitants that live\nin Toram. We migrated to this moving forest called\nMovere to avoid Coenubia's attacks...
Erva Tronc...Eumano...Movere Forest...\nSo many unfamiliar words. I was expecting them\ntho. Argh~, my head is about to explode...
Hey, you haven't said anything yet, do you\nactually understand?
Aye, aye, aye...\nDifficult words go in one ear and out the\nother~...
What's that supposed to mean?
It's because we are suddenly being thrown into a\nnew world. I've received a brief explanation, but\nthere are still many things I don't understand...
That's normal.\nI'll explain everything in detail if necessary,..\nBy the way...
Why are you guys bringing a Lixi with you?
I've also heard the townsfolk calling this thing\nwith that...What exactly is a Lixi?
To add to that, it would be nice if you could also\ntell us what other tribes or monsters there are in\nthis world...
Absolutely.\nJust ask me what you wanna know.\nI'll answer to the best of my ability.
Tell me about the humans here.
Tell me about the monsters.
Tell me about Lixi.
Tell me about Coenubia.
I'm all good, thanks!
[64ffff]ASKED[ffffff]
Fine. First, let's talk about...the Sapiens\nthat exist in Toram.
Besides Eumanos like us, in the world of Toram,\nthere are also Ranas that live in water and Lixis.
Although mainly living in water, sometimes the\nRanas spend time on land to sell stuff collected\nfrom the water. We interact with them quite often.
There are also some other tribes, although they\nare few in number.
Aye, so the things that appeared from the water\nto peek at us and knocked Coenubias out by\nspraying water were the Ranas, not monsters...
Monsters? The creatures you saw in the forest are\nunique to this world. They're herbivores and prey\non us, but we don't call them monsters...
Aye~, they look so scary. Besides, you never know\nwhen you'll become their food, you still think\nthat they're not monsters?
They're also living organisms in this forest.\nWe sometimes fight them to protect ourselves, but
we don't kill them for no reason.\nBut when it comes to the dragons, it's a different\nstory.
Dragons? Are there dragons too in this world?
Unlike the other living things in this forest,\nthis world rather, the dragons exist for nothing.\nThey're just evil beings that kill for fun.
The dragons and Coenubias are the ones we should\nbe calling monsters...
I see...In our world, the dragons coexist with\nnature. The evil ones exist too, though.
However, most of them usually help people.\nUm, I see that's not the case here~...
Right, we need to ask about that...\nYou all said that this thing could be a Lixi,\nwhat's a Lixi?
The Lixis are also the indigenous tribes of Toram\njust like us and the Ranas.They used to live\nunderground and avoid interacting with others.
However, Coenubias possessed most of them and\nturned them into their armies...
What...? So that means this thing was also sent\nto our world as a spy...?
Maybe he was also brought to your world to see if\nthe Lixis that have become their armies would be\nan effective means of attack in your world...
Aye?
Where they came from still remains a mystery.\nThey are an amorphous colony with intelligence\nthat invaded Toram long ago...
Aye? A colony...? What's that?
It's a group of many creatures of the same kind\nthat come together...
The colony sent out Coenubias that could control\nothers to Toram and they were controlling all\nLixis, one of the 3 indigenous tribes.
It happened at such a tremendous speed that at one\npoint, 2/3 of Toram was under their control...
Whoa...Had we not made them leave Eldenbaum, our\nworld might have ended up like that too...
However, since we learned that Coenubia's\nweakness is water, the Eumanos and the Ranas have\nbeen working together to fight back and
we have succeeded in getting back half of Toram.\nBut Coenubias are still at an advantage in areas\nwhere there is not much water.
Lately they've also come up with a countermeasure\nto attack us and our battle has reached\ndeadlock...
This world is Coenubias' stronghold...I bet they\nwill have the advantage over us in many aspects.\nThis battle would only get tougher and tougher...
Huff~...I guess it's gonna take some time before I\ncan do business again.
Since I'm already in this world, I wanna be the\nfirst Cule to secure a route for selling goods\nhere, you know. C'mon, do your best!
What are you gonna do if you don't fight with us?\nI heard from King Elbano that you're good with\nyour hammer, tho?
Oh gosh! That king just says whatever he wants!!\nI'm a merchant, not a warrior you know!
Umm...Anyway, I can't feel the presence of\nCoenubia from this thing tho...
But based on your story, it controlled monsters\nwith crystals and
there were also many crystals on its body.\nThen it transformed into a gigantic monster and\nwas acting as Coenubia's army...
Yeah, and when this adventurer got cornered and\nwas on the verge of death, a goddess named Grecia\nshot it with the light arrow...
It then fell from the cliff into the sea.\nPerhaps Coenubia disappeared because it was\nexposed to water...
We've also fought off some Lixis that had become\nmonsters by pushing them into the water before.\nHowever, the Lixis that fell into the water...
They got eaten by the crystals and vanished along\nwith the crystals...There has never been a case\nwhere only the Lixi would survive.
Was it because of Grecia's light arrow then?\nThat's why only the Coenubia disappeared...?
If it was because of the goddess' power in your\nworld, it'd be difficult to make it happen here...\nMaybe Anono is our hope to restore the Lixis.
Hey, she said you could be their hope.\nC'mon, do your best!
Aye, what?
...Maybe it's fate that we migrated to this\nMovere forest so that we could meet you all...
Oh please, now you're exaggerating!
No, I'm not.\nWe couldn't escape from Coenubias no matter where\nwe moved to...
And as we became desperate, you guys showed up\nbefore us and were actually after them.\nIf it isn't fate, then what is it...?
Wait a sec...So you've been migrating a lot?\nAnd Coenubias also exist around here?
Yeah, we've recently confirmed their invasion here\ntoo...So far still not so much damage but I heard\nthe forest is being destroyed from the edge...
Ma'am, I have received news that the village on\nthe outskirts of the town has been attacked by a\ndragon and they're seeking immediate help!!
What?! I had no idea that they've already come\nthis close!!
I think we are meant to meet for a reason.\nWhy don't you back them up?
I should help and get them to be in my debt so\nI can expand my business here...\nAlright, I'm in!!
Aye, I'm going too then!!
No, you're staying here with me!
Uh?! But why?!
Because you're probably our hope to restore the\nLixis in this world to their original state.\nYou had better stay away from danger.
Huh, that's not fun!!
Besides, this town will become more vulnerable\nwhile the adventurer and the main Eumano soldiers\nare away. If you and I don't help, who will?
I see! Aye, I'll guard this town with Kunon then!
I'll take care of Anono, so don't worry about\nhim...
I've been thinking of correcting the way he talks\ntoo. It's weird. So this is my chance.
While you're away, I'll give him intensive lessons\nto slowly fix the way he talks, hihihi...
Thank you!\nYou can take these guys with you!
They're still young, but they'll be the main\nsoldiers who guard this town in the future.\nI'm sure they'll be helpful.
Oh wait, I almost forgot.\nYou should take out the Dryad Jewel you received\nfrom Arbol.
The Dryad Jewel already contains a portion of\nArbol's power.
Legend has it that a legendary weapon will appear\nwhen it is filled with 2 more kinds of power\nrelated to the Eumano.
I don't know where you can find the last one, but\nI'll try funneling a portion of my power into it\nas the second power. Heave-ho!!
The Dryad Jewel changed form and turned into\nTree Deity Rod!!
It's my first time seeing a jewel that changes\nform when filled with power...\nThis world is amazing...
Alright! Let's go then!!
You report what happened in the village to\nthe leader...
Having a new Sproutling with us is a good thing.\nMuti, as a Eumano soldier, I hope you'll use your\npower to help us.
Y-yes, ma'am!!
Also, what about this?\nThe rod turned into this because of the light\nthat was emitted when Muti became a Sproutling...
What?!\nSo 3 kinds of power have filled the jewel?!\nThat means this is the legendary weapon...
But this thing is sharp everywhere, so how can\nwe hold it...?
What? Hmm...\nPerhaps it's not yet complete.\nI'm gonna find out about it, just keep it for now.
You report the information from the village chief\nthat the dragon was looking for the\n"Blessing Bearer"...
Umm, so that dragon has sniffed out the presence\nof the "Blessing Bearer"...
So who's that "Blessing Bearer"?
Once upon a time, a large number of dragons came\nto attack this forest...
T-then what happened next?
They were trying to devour all life in the forest\nincluding the Eumanos. We were in great danger.
Thanks to the "Blessing-Bearer", all the dragons\nwere wiped out with a lot of water and the entire\nforest is blessed with water...
With a lot of water you say...?\nThat "Blessing-Bearer" must have been an amazing\nperson!
Yeah, but it seems that the "Blessing-Bearer" is\nnot a good fighter by nature.
And it's quite dangerous because the dragon was\nobserving her. May I ask you to help her?
Dragon or Coenubia, either way it's better to have\nmore people on your side when it comes to a fight!
I'm coming too!\nI want my power as a Sproutling to be useful!
We're coming too!\nWe will go with Captain Muti!!
Wait, whaat?!\nC-captain? Meee?!
You're a Sproutling now, isn't it obvious?
Eh, er, um...really? All right.\nBut I've never led the troops before,\nso I need your support!
Sure!!
Hey, the Eumano soldiers are probably thinking\nthat they could become a Sproutling too like Muti\nif they follow us...What do you think?
Aye~, Pelulu~, help meee~!\nKunon is too strict about how I talk!!
Hey~! Anono, where are you going?!\nI'm not finished with you!!
W-well, Kunon...\nYou shouldn't be so strict on him...
Yes, I should! Because my mother, Curonne, is\nextremely strict with me too when it comes to\nlanguage. Improper language must be fixed ASAP...
Anyway, I heard Anono learned to speak from you,\nis that true? If it's true, I should teach you how\nto speak properly too...
Eh? What? No, no, no, it has nothing to do with\nme. I don't remember ever teaching him. Maybe he\njust picked up my words incorrectly, hahaha!!
...Well, fine then. Maybe next time, because you\nseem to be in a hurry...Okay, Anono, c'mon!\nLet's get back to our special intensive lesson!!
Oh my gosh!\nPeluluuu, you heartless girl!!
Ooh!\nI'm glad you're okay, auntie!!
O-ouch!\nW-what was that for...?
Shouldn't you call me sister instead of auntie?
Okay, okay, I'm sowwie~!!
...Hey, how old are gods actually?\nSurprisingly, they all look young...
Oh dear, are you suspecting something?
A-anyway, it's an honor to meet the\n"Blessing-Bearer". I'm Kinda, the leader of the\nEumanos. You say your name is Vasaria, right?
We Eumanos need water to survive. Since you're the\nGoddess of Water, I would like you to stay in the\nforest and be with us for many years to come.
I'm a god of another world. I'll need to return to\nthe world I belong to one day...But, I'm afraid\nI'll need to stay here for a while, is that okay?
I couldn't wish for anything better! I will\nprotect you until the day you return to your\nworld, so please bless us with plenty of water!
Thank you. Also...I had no idea that you have\nbuilt such a big town, so it's hard for me to say,\nbut...
Don't you think it would be better if you leave\nthis forest?
W-why is that?
I've observed this forest many times from the sky\nsince I came...
What, but there's no way a human can fly...\nOops, sorry, I forgot that you're a god...
This forest doesn't simply float around like this\nwithout a reason, it seems to be moving because\nit is being controlled by something...
Hmm?!
...I've witnessed this forest moved and narrowly\navoided a collision with a huge landmass many\ntimes before...
Hey, perhaps this forest has thoughts and that's\nwhy it moves to avoid the collision...
I thought so too at first, but I've seen a\nsuspicious figure on Mt. Vulcani behind this\nforest that obviously doesn't look like you...
The Eumano soldiers have also received reports of\nsuspicious figure sightings in the forest.
But we haven't been able to investigate as no one\ncan describe where exactly they saw it...\nWe'll go start an investigation immediately!
There's no need to worry about the figure you\nguys are talking about...
Why though?!
Do you know something about it?
...Maybe it's time...
What?
Oh, nothing...Don't worry about it, but...\nIf you're curious, just go to Mt. Vulcani and\nsee it for yourself...
If you guys are curious too, you can go with him\nto check it out...
W-what?! Can I really go?!
Let's go to that Mt. Vulcani or whatever place!\nThey say seeing is believing, right...?!
Aye! Let's go, let's go!!
Anono~, I haven't finished teaching you to speak\nproper language, you know?
Aye~!! Noo, I don't wanna do it anymore!
Kunon, you shouldn't bully such a small kid!
Oh, auntie...oops, I mean sister! It's not what\nyou think. I'm only teaching this guy to speak\nproperly because the way he speaks is horrible...
Oh yeah? Your mother used to tell you to stop\nusing rough language when you were little, I can't\nbelieve that now you're teaching someone else...
Now I'm kinda curious about how the way you speak\nhas changed. Let me hear it!
Whoa!!
Oh, no lemme go~!!
You guys may go ahead.\nI'll take care of these kids...
Oh, right. Here, take this...\nI hope it will be useful for you...
You received Talisman of God from Vasaria.
...So, we can't really say that the condition of\nthe ark is better now...
Hmm...apparently it can't be fixed perfectly with\nEumano's technology...\nWhat should we do...
I'm sorry to interrupt, but I think winds and air\ncurrents are not the only factors that prevent the\nark from flying properly, are they?
So what else?!
The sky in this world has areas called force\nfields in which a particular force exists.
We need to avoid that force nicely and sometimes\ntake advantage of it. Even a flying creature will\nfall in the blink of an eye if it fails to do so.
So what are we supposed to do to avoid and take\nadvantage of those force fields?
Use weredragon's technology! We have a system that\ncan perform that easily. We only need to install\nit on the ship.
That's awesome!!\nLet's go to have it installed now...
However...Up until now we've been asking help from\nthe Eumanos, we can't just switch to the\nweredragon's technology so easily...
It's fine. There's a limit to our technology too.\nIt's not easy to overcome this obstacle...
That unknown technology may be a breath of fresh\nair to the ship...There's no need to hesitate.\nJust go for it!
I appreciate that...\nI'll do so then!
It's settled then! Alright, let's take the\nark to...
No, we can't! I'm not sure that we can get to\nDraco Town safely with the ship like this.
It would be better to bring the stuff we need to\nfix the ship and those who will fix it here.
Please allow me to help!
Aye! Me too, I wanna help too!
We need you two to watch the ark.\nThis adventurer, Zianga and I will go to see the\nweredragons' leader...
What? Why can't I go with you?
What if the ark breaks into pieces when we return?\nAll of our efforts will be in vain, right?
Hm, I see...
I got it. Leave the ark to us!
I'm going with you!
Hmm, I think it'll be less troublesome if you just\nstay and wait here though...
What are you talking about?! I'm currently the\ncaptain of this ark, so I must go to greet those\nwho are gonna repair it!!
I see!\nAlright then, let's head to Draco Town now!
Hmm...You're right. We won't know how many\nCoenubias have occupied Toram if we just stay in\nthis Movere Silva...
Hm, considering that the Wind Ark can now stay\nafloat in the air, this could be our chance to\ninvestigate the current situation in Toram...
Kunon, may I ask you to investigate it?
Okay. Just the right timing to test out\nthe performance of the ark that has been repaired.
So you want us to go with her too...?
Nope, there's something else I want you to do.
What? W-what is it...?
I'm thinking of joining forces with those who are\nagainst Coenubias.
First, I'd like to form an alliance with\nthe Ranas.
I'll send Muti as a special agent, so I'd like you\nto go with him.
S-special agent...? M-me?!
I see, alright, we'll go with him.
Since this is an important negotiation,\nyou're gonna reward us handsomely, right?
I'll do my best!
Okay!
Alright, let's do this...\nBy the way, where can we find a Rana?
We also don't know where the land of the Ranas is.
But a few Ranas live in Fugitive Lake Swamp,\nso I think it'd be a good idea to go there and\ntalk to them first.
Okay, I'll take the ark to Toram to check\nthe situation there then. Anono, let's go!
What?! No, I wanna go with Pelulu and\nthe adventurer!
What if the parts repaired by the homunculi break\ndown? Only you can fix them since you were the\nonly one who saw them fix the ark, you know?
You are needed on the ark.\nAnd guess what, I'll go with you too.
Hmm...Okay...
Do your best to protect the ark, okay...?\nAlright, shall we go then?
